title: Replication Package: Communication Network Analysis of Sarcasm in Indonesia's Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) Discourse on Platform X
description: Permanent Open Science replication archive containing multi-annotator gold-standard emotion and sarcasm corpora, AoIR 3.0-pseudonymized directed network interaction edge lists (|V|=971, |E|=666), TERGM temporal network evolution phases, spatial epidemiological ground-truthing benchmarks across 10 Indonesian provinces, Aspect Category Sentiment Analysis (ACSA) matrices, fine-tuned IndoBERT PyTorch inference pipelines, and automated test validation suites. Formatted in accordance with International Communication Association (ICA) and Oxford University Press Open Science guidelines.
